name: The Kesmark range with the Dombas hub's district
description: The Kesmark range as it is (its 40 km, its detail areas, the country beyond) with a third detail area 13 km square at 20 m round the Dombas hub towards Novo Varosd, where battery 21 fights NATO's war (track O, O6), and the district's tracks.
status: track O, O6 (26 Nov 2026): NATO's district (docs/campaign/12_ORDERS_MAPS_AND_THE_CAMPAIGN.md section 8)
source: game value: sam3d estimate (the area's size and spacing as the plan's about 12 km at 10-20 m; the tracks and the village are SAM3D's, on the country's ground and roads, data/maps/pannonia.json)
notes: A district's map extends the range (simcore/terrain_map.hpp LoadMap). The country's map has no road to the hub: the hub's track joins it to the Novo Varosd road, and is the district's own (the ground war's roads are the country's, unchanged).

detail.notes: The Dombas helicopter base (-48, 8) and the Cegled rail junction (-35, 15) with the fields between: 20 m ground (roadmap R6, 15.6). Its edges are nodes of the far ground's 500 m ground.

roads.name: The hub's road from the Novo Varosd road
roads.notes: From the Novo Varosd-Kesmark road by the Cegled junction to the helicopter base, by the regiment's and the battery's positions.

detail_settlements.name: Dombas
detail_settlements.notes: The village the helicopter base is named after, SAM3D's.
